## Installation

### Userscript (Tampermonkey)

[Install Userscript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diyorsattarov7/lolalytics-persist/main/userscript/lolalytics-persist.user.js)

### Browser Extension (Chrome / Brave)

[Download Extension](https://github.com/diyorsattarov7/lolalytics-persist/releases/latest/download/lolalytics-persist-extension.zip)

Extract the ZIP and load the extension through your browser's extensions page.
